text:
Type: small striped flatwoven rug
Use: covering a small floor spot, by a bed, door or sink; hallway, kitchen, bedroom, entryway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: flatwoven fibre with a fine ribbed texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, crisp white stripes
Shape: rectangular, flat and thin, evenly spaced thin pinstripes running lengthwise, clean edges, compact
Feel: graphic, crisp, tidy
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, black accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: SFTEN
product.description: Easy to keep clean since it is machine washable.
